Key design decisions recorded (disclosed in the PR + ADR-XXX):

- **Emit shape = one row per post-collapse record (GQ-10 verbatim:**
  "published site rows = records after derivation-collapse"). A cluster's
  non-canonical members nest in the canonical row's `copies[]` — never an
  excess row per copy (F-511's inflation ends at the emit shape). Canonical
  member = the member that is `left` (origin) and never `right` (republish)
  across the cluster's `derived_from` links; else the smallest member id
  (the site id itself). A licence-refused canonical yields to the next
  emitted member — a site never loses its only row to a licence refusal.
- **Dossier `records` stays the member-record count** (upstream records,
  copies included — "412 camera records"); the published interval
  [lower, upper] sits beside it verbatim (SIG-CONF-005: record count plus
  the range — the L3 illustration has records > upper).
- **`count_bounds` extracted from `count_intervals`** (resolution) — the
  export calls the dep's own bound computation verbatim, never a second
  implementation.
- **`multi_view` is a separate array field**, never folded into
  `possible_duplicates[]` — same-layer co-located distinct records are
  classed multi-view, not duplicates (GQ-10).
- **`same_as` members** (human-accepted joins) list under `copies[]` with
  `basis: "same_as"` — they are site members joined by a recorded review
  decision, never labelled C0/C1/C2.
- **Honest absence:** no completed run → every field emits its
  `{"not_recorded": ...}` state on every row; a run present → every
  record carries measured values (`copies: []` / `possible_duplicates: []`
  for no-link records).

## Phase 2 — implementation

Landed, matching the matrix row-for-row:

- **`resolution/camera_sites.py`** — `count_bounds(members, applied,
  possible, site_members)` extracted as the single bound implementation;
  `count_intervals` delegates to it (upper = applied edges only, lower
  additionally folds possible-duplicate links within `near_max_m`,
  restricted to the requested member subset; `None` → explicit absence).
  `_clusters_from_edges` + `_link_stamp` unchanged in behaviour —
  `site_id`/`relation_type`/evidence were already recorded by P35.46.
- **`resolution/camera_sites_pg.py`** — `read_resolved_site_runs`
  widened: `applied_edges`/`possible_edges` carry full link rows
  (`left`,`right`,`disposition`,`relation`,`tier`,`site_id`,
  `evidence` — the `_link_stamp` JSON verbatim: `link_kind`, `basis`,
  `shared_upstream_ref`, `lineage_ids`, `distance_m`, reason).
- **`exports/dedup.py`** (new) — `DedupView` + `build_dedup_view`:
  site clusters from applied edges (C0 `duplicate_target` roots; C1/C2
  recorded original/republish direction; deterministic canonical
  member), `member_site` map, `site_members`, per-record field dicts
  (`site_id`, `copies[]` with `basis` c0/c1/c2/`same_as` + source +
  upstream id + `display`, `possible_duplicates[]` with `record`,
  `site_id`, `distance_m`, `reason`, `source`, `display`,
  `multi_view[]` for same-source co-located records — never duplicates,
  `n_independent_lineages` + display), `interval_block` (dep's
  `count_bounds` + SIG-CONF-005 display verbatim), `dossier_inflation`
  (published_rows vs lineage_roots, measured vs ≤ 1.02 target),
  `run_key`, `declared_distance_m`, `lineage_not_evaluable`.
- **`exports/spine_export.py`** — `dedup_view` built once from
  `raw["materialized_site_runs"]` + the export's member records +
  `raw["claim_lineage"]`; `_slice_sites` emits the canonical member
  only, stamps the view's fields on every emitted row, and a
  licence-refused canonical yields to the next emitted member;
  `_sites_specs` registers all new fields; `_SiteSlices.nested_members`
  carries non-canonical members into `_claim_slots` so a nested copy's
  own claims still file under its own compartment; `resolved_sites_
  metric` publishes the interval (the point "N resolved sites" wording
  withdrawn per the design note — the range is the contracted form);
  `_map_layer` draws canonical members only + `count_interval`;
  `_coverage` joins the same view; `<comp>/count_interval.json`
  (`sig.count-interval/1`) per member-bearing compartment; dossier
  `rollup.count_interval` + `rollup.dossier_inflation_vs_lineage_roots`.
- **`exports/dossier_sources.py`** — `DossierContributionPlan` gains
  `dedup_intervals`/`dedup_inflation`/`nested_member_rows`;
  `totals.count_interval` + `totals.dossier_inflation_vs_lineage_roots`

- **`exports/published_record.py`** — sparse `dedup` block on
